current_math_audit_2026_11_20.proven_in_current_manuscript: For the closed normal-trivial curve degree e=d−2 in smooth X_d⊂P^4: H3 of tubular complement is Z^{b_d}⊕Z/e; explicit K_c deformation retract is S1∨S2; actual focus complement has H1=Z, H2=Z^{2g+2}, H3=Z^{b_d+2g+1}⊕Z/e, H4=Z^{2g+1}. Focus boundary is one-unipotent-monodromy torus bundle with integral Heisenberg π1, and the closed-curve face Betti numbers are (1,2g+2,4g+3,4g+3,2g+2,1).
current_math_audit_2026_11_20.independently_calculated: Symbolic Euler formulas and finite substitutions d=6..10, including b3(X6)=520, g=3, actual complement free Betti (1,1,8,527,7,0) and torsion order 4; Wang Smith normal form of M−I= [[0,1],[0,0]] yielding no boundary torsion.
current_math_audit_2026_11_20.primary_source: Oscar Randal-Williams, Monodromy and mapping class groups of 3-dimensional hypersurfaces, Math. Ann. 391 (2025), 1965-2003, §2.1, DOI 10.1007/s00208-024-02951-4, checked for integral cohomology of smooth hypersurface threefold X_d. Standard focus monodromy from the paper's existing cited Zung source.
current_math_audit_2026_11_20.scope_limits: These are topological results for the explicitly defined focus-block domain. They do not establish the integer homology inclusion maps of its boundary into the actual complement, matching of whole Lagrangian foliations, action/Maslov data, global threefold Lagrangian fibration, or new literature priority.
